title: Middle School Winter Dance
description:
The SCS Student Council invites all SCS middle school students to a “Helping Hollywood” Winter Dance on Thursday, January 23rd from 6:00-7:30 pm in the school gym.

Students can look forward to a glamorous evening with Hollywood-themed decorations, a faux red carpet, dancing, and delicious food. The school will provide pizza, while snacks, drinks, and sweets will be generously supplied by the PAC and parent volunteers. Additionally, the student council will be hosting a fundraiser, and students are encouraged to bring optional cash donations. All funds raised will be donated to the American Red Cross efforts in LA and the surrounding areas.

The dress code for the evening will be free-dress or nicer (please reference the policy on the website).

Drop-off will follow the same procedures as the morning car line, while pick-up will commence at 7:25 PM and continue through 7:35 PM. Cars will line up similarly to the morning carline routine and students will be released through the auditorium doors.

See the email from Ms. Ilise for information!
